title: Overview of AWS Services
dek: Learn about the various categories and naming conventions of AWS services.
author: Daniel Mansfield

blocks.text: AWS provides a vast array of cloud services suitable for different applications. These services support both startups and large enterprises, helping them reduce IT costs, scale operations, and innovate quickly. AWS can host web applications, develop mobile apps, perform real-time data analytics, and store large data backups, among other functions.

items: AWS services are divided into various categories including:
Compute
Storage
Database
Analytics
Networking
Security
Mobile apps
Internet of Things
Machine Learning

blocks.title: Categories
items: AWS offers services across multiple categories.
Each category serves different use cases.
Some AWS service names clearly indicate their function:
Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (compute service)
Amazon Simple Storage Service (storage service)
Amazon Relational Database Service (relational database service)
Others may not be as straightforward, such as:
Amazon Route 53 (domain name service)

blocks.title: Naming Conventions
items: Service names often reflect their functionality.
Understanding names can help identify the right service for a task.
AWS offers fully managed services, meaning AWS handles server management, maintenance, and scaling.
Examples include:
Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (uses Kubernetes)
Amazon FSx for Lustre (based on Lustre file system)
Amazon Elasticsearch Service (based on Elasticsearch)

blocks.title: Managed Services
items: Fully managed services simplify deployment and maintenance.
AWS takes care of underlying infrastructure.
Familiarity with AWS service categories and names aids in exam preparation.
Recognizing keywords can help eliminate incorrect options on tests.
For instance, knowing "container" relates to Amazon Elastic Container Service or Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service.

blocks.title: Exam Preparation
items: Understanding service categories is crucial for AWS exams.
Recognizing keywords helps in answering questions correctly.
AWS offers a wide range of services categorized by function.
Service names often indicate their purpose, aiding in identification.
Fully managed services reduce the burden of infrastructure management.
Knowledge of these services is essential for AWS certification exams.

blocks.title: Quick Recap
items: AWS provides diverse services across categories.
Service names are key to understanding their functions.
Managed services simplify operations and are exam-relevant.
